editorial:
Imagine being born for one reason: to keep your sister alive. That is the heavy heart of this family drama. Sara and Brian Fitzgerald seem to have it all until their young daughter Kate is diagnosed with leukemia. In a desperate move, they have another baby, Anna, specifically to be a donor for Kate. Years later, Anna sues her parents for the right to make her own medical choices. The story pulls you into a messy, emotional courtroom battle that questions what love and loyalty really mean. It is a tearjerker that does not shy away from hard questions about family and sacrifice.

The acting is the real standout here. Cameron Diaz gives a raw, emotional performance as the fierce mother, while Abigail Breslin shines as the conflicted Anna. The pacing can feel slow at times, and some scenes are heavy to sit through. Still, if you enjoy emotional family dramas that make you think, this one is worth your time. Stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray for the best picture.
endingExplained: In the final twist, you learn Kate actually asked Anna to sue so she could stop fighting and let go. Anna was never trying to abandon her sister; she was honoring Kate's wish to die peacefully. Kate passes away quietly at home, surrounded by family. The lawsuit ends, and the Fitzgeralds find a new, fragile kind of peace together, redefining what healing means.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves emotional family dramas and tearjerkers.
